theme: Making an enzyme survive the heat
title: Thermostable Enzyme Redesign: Epistasis-Screened Mutation Stacking
strategies: install-nothing-extra baseline: pick the single best individually-feasible stabilizing mutation (reproduces the checker's own baseline B, ~0.1)

rank-and-stack greedy: sort candidate mutations by individual stability delta and add them while a naive additive activity budget holds -- ignores the epistasis table and active-site crowding entirely, so it both clashes on antagonistic top-ranked pairs and misses synergistic pairs ranked just outside the naive cut

epistasis- and crowding-aware exhaustive search: screens every candidate mutation SET against the sparse pairwise epistasis table (stability AND activity corrections) and explicitly bounds how many selected mutations fall inside the active-site neighbourhood -- finds antagonism-free, synergy-exploiting combinations the rank-and-stack recipe cannot see
